title: Meta Transactions on Edgeware
body:
**About Biconomy**


Biconomy is building multichain transaction infrastructure for next-generation web 3 applications. Through Biconomy's powerful and easy to use APIs, developers can enable a simple and customized transaction journey so that their end users don't get frustrated by blockchain complexities. By solving key pain points at the crypto transactional layer, Biconomy is on a mission to simplify Web 3 experiences that will drive mass adoption

Our relayer infrastructure enables gasless transactions, improves the onboarding journey for the end-user, and relieves the developer from building such an infrastructure. Our current infrastructure has been built on Ethereum (Ropsten, Kovan and Rinkeby as our testnets), Matic Network (testnet and mainnet), binance smart chain (testnet and mainnet), Xdai ( mainent), moonbeam ( test net) and ava labs ( testnet)

**Project Goals for Edgeware :**

1. Build a meta transaction protocol that runs on the edgeware network which involve a set of smart contracts, setting up relayer infrastructure and meta transaction standards for edgeware 
2. Build a forwarder contract that will allow the end users to pay fees in the stable tokens and EDG 


Applying Meta Transactions on Edgeware  :

Building a relayer infrastructure involves building components that handle different aspects of a blockchain transaction which involves creating the blockchain transaction in a correct format, signing the transaction with correct relayer so it doesn’t get stuck on network, choosing the right gasPrice for the transaction, handling long pending transactions and keeping the latency minimum while relaying the transaction.
